headline: Prime Intellect Releases Prime Agent: An Open-Source RLM Harness Where Sub-Agents Are Function Calls Inside Persistent IPython Kernel
context: Prime Intellect has open-sourced Prime Agent, a coding and research harness built on two abstractions: the Recursive Language Model, which turns sub-agent calls into functions inside a persistent IPython kernel, and the Continual Harness, which lets the agent edit its own prompts

sources.name: MarkTechPost
sources.summary: Prime Intellect has open-sourced Prime Agent, a coding and research harness built on two abstractions: the Recursive Language Model, which turns sub-agent calls into functions inside a persistent IPython kernel, and the Continual Harness, which lets the agent edit its own prompts, skills, memory, and sub-agent specs mid-run. With Opus 5 it reports 95.5% RHAE Best@1 on ARC-AGI-3, above the reported human expert baseline of 95.4%. The post Prime Intellect Releases Prime Agent: An Open-Source RLM Harness Where Sub-Agents Are Function Calls Inside Persistent IPython Kernel appeared first on MarkTechPost .
